SMTO-SKL-0034 — SMTO needs to know which Google account to use for Drive

GUID: 3a7916cd-1afa-523f-95c5-eba1488c7082
Slug: google-drive-account-ambiguous
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • You have more than one Google account connected, and any of them could be used for Drive. SMTO won't guess, so it stopped without touching your files.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list the connected Google accounts, and find the email address that owns the files you mean. Seeing the list makes it clear which account holds the right Drive.
  2. Repeat your request and name the account, for example "Using my work Google account, find the budget file in Drive." Naming the account lets SMTO pick it without guessing.
  3. If you no longer use one of the accounts, ask SMTO to disconnect it. With fewer connected accounts, SMTO can choose the right one on its own next time.

What success looks like

  • SMTO completes the Drive request and reports the account you named.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't remove an account other people may rely on without asking them first.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • More than one connected google_account is eligible for this Drive operation and no explicit account_ref or accepted binding selects one.

What this means

  • Shared Google selection finds multiple eligible accounts and no unique explicit or accepted binding for Drive. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Shared Google selection finds multiple eligible accounts and no unique explicit or accepted binding for Drive.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect safe google_drive.accounts candidates and accepted identity.

How to fix it

  • resolve_account raised account_ambiguous because several eligible google_account records exist and neither an explicit account_ref nor a single accepted parameter binding selects one. List candidates with google_drive.accounts and pass the exact account_ref for the intended account.
  • Pass the exact account_ref from google_drive.accounts.

Retry and execution caution

  • Pass the exact account_ref from google_drive.accounts.

How to verify the fix

  • The operation uses the intended exact account_ref.

What not to do

  • Do not expose credentials, content or resumable URLs.
  • Do not blindly repeat uncertain writes.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
